invalid.name: export_request_scope_out_of_date
invalid.reason: Out of date is a display group, never an export scope (AMS-047, AMS-052).

invalid.name: export_request_without_scope
invalid.reason: Both Export actions name what they export: gists, teachings or all (AMS-052).

invalid.name: export_request_that_also_verifies
invalid.reason: Exporting never changes, verifies, pins or discards what it exports (AMS-052).

invalid.name: export_request_on_the_edit_command
invalid.reason: One command serves both Export actions; no alias or other command stands in for it (AMS-052, CDRY-022).

invalid.name: export_gist_state_out_of_date
invalid.reason: Out of date is never a fourth verification_state; the export carries the stored state (AMS-047, AMS-052).

invalid.name: export_gist_state_stale
invalid.reason: The stored states are exactly Unverified, Verified and Discarded (AMS-014).

invalid.name: export_verified_gist_without_evidence
invalid.reason: A gist never becomes Verified with empty evidence_refs, so none is exported that way (AMS-014).

invalid.name: export_evidence_ref_embeds_the_diff_body
invalid.reason: EvidenceRefs go out as pointers, never as copies of what they point to (AMS-006, AMS-052).

invalid.name: export_evidence_ref_embeds_a_log
invalid.reason: A TestRun pointer carries a summary hash, not the log (section 3.3).

invalid.name: export_gists_scope_carries_a_rule
invalid.reason: An export of notes only holds no taught rule (AMS-052).

invalid.name: export_teachings_scope_carries_a_gist

invalid.name: export_rule_without_lock_state

invalid.name: export_gist_with_display_group_field

invalid.name: reply_record_claims_following
invalid.reason: The record states inclusion only; inclusion never establishes that a rule was followed (AMS-051, DL-116).

invalid.name: reply_record_bare_rule_id

invalid.name: reply_record_rule_without_version

invalid.name: reply_record_rule_listed_twice
invalid.reason: A rule included once is recorded once.
